allowedSourceMaterial.overview: A New York University professor returns from a rescue mission to the Amazon rainforest with the footage shot by a lost team of documentarians who were making a film about the area's local cannibal tribes.

facts.overview: A New York University professor returns from a rescue mission to the Amazon rainforest with the footage shot by a lost team of documentarians who were making a film about the area's local cannibal tribes.
facts.title: Cannibal Holocaust

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: A rescue team retrieved the reels left behind by a vanished film crew, but what reality did their cameras capture deep in the rainforest?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: After a rescue mission in the Amazon rainforest, a New York University professor returns carrying reels shot by a vanished documentary crew that set out to film local cannibal tribes.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Heavy, suspenseful horror marked by grim dread and steady tension, best suited for focused solitary viewing.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Ruggero Deodato constructs a grim, suspenseful horror investigation centered on recovered footage, examining mortal danger and remote peril with unrelenting tension.
